section_summary.extract_value: This section details the statistical analysis methods used for a study, including Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) to determine the factorial validity of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) using various fit indices (χ2, GFI, NFI, CFI, TLI, RMSEA). It also describes the verification of multivariate normality, assessment of internal consistency via Cronbach's alpha, and concurrent validity through correlations between BAS scores and BMI, body image dissatisfaction, and accuracy estimation, as well as criterion validity using one-way ANOVA. The analyses were performed using SPSS 20.0 AMOS and SPSS 17.0 software.
